sn_aia_tool.description: this tool assist in finding all access levels allocated in the provided location name with input and also return location sys_id for given location name. If lobby name is present and is in given location, then just fetch that lobby record directly.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"location_name","description":"name of location specified by user","mandatory":false},{"name":"lobby_name","description":"name of lobby to access directly if mentioned by user","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Guardian Fetch Access from Location
